newsitem.title: BAHAMAS: Hutchison in Bahamas hotel deal.
newsitem.headline: Hutchison in Bahamas hotel deal.

text.p: Hutchison Port Property, a subsidiary of Hutchison Whampoa Ltd has reached agreement in principle to buy two hotels from the Bahamas government in Freeport, Grand Bahamas.
Prime Minister Hubert Ingraham hailed the proposed sale of the Lucayan Beach Hotel and the Grand Bahama Beach Hotel to the Anglo-Chinese investor as a "good deal".
Grand Bahama Port Authority chairman Edward St.George pegged the investment at $100 million.
Hutchison Ports (UK) Ltd managing director Derek Harrington said the project would provide significant jobs and career opportunities for Bahamians.
HPP has also agreed in principle to acquire the private Clarion Atlantik Beach Hotel and an adjacent beach property.

Harrington said the design of a resort complex was being completed and would involve a programme of renovations and refurbishment. HPP also plans to build additional hotel facilities on the vacant site, Harrington said.

"This project will involve substantial investment and when viewed in conjunction with Hutchison's prior investment in the container port on Grand Bahama, it further emphasises Hutchison's commitment to Bahamians," he said. The initial investment in the container terminal is $88 milion.
